edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
owner state variable authorises the onlyOwner check.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal nominatedOwner.
nominatedOwner is consumed by the acceptOwnership check.
selfDestruct is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
Caller identity gates execution of selfDestruct.
selfDestruct executes the SELFDESTRUCT opcode on the beneficiary.
Cached beneficiary local is passed into selfdestruct.
initiationTime plus SELFDESTRUCT_DELAY is compared with now.
block.timestamp decides whether the destruction delay elapsed.
selfDestructInitiated flag gates the destruction path.
updateRates is restricted by the onlyOracle modifier.
oracle address is compared to msg.sender for authorisation.
updateRates delegates its body to internalUpdateRates.
internalUpdateRates writes the rates mapping entries.
internalUpdateRates records lastRateUpdateTimes per currency.
timeSent is validated against now plus ORACLE_FUTURE_LIMIT.
internalUpdateRates calls rateOrInverted for each currency key.
rateOrInverted reads the stored rate for the currency key.
newInverseRate is produced with multiplication and subtraction math.
Adjusted inverted rate is written back into the rates mapping.
rateIsStale compares stored update time plus stale period against now.
priceUpdateLock is reset after a successful rate update.
Fallback performs delegatecall when useDELEGATECALL is enabled.
useDELEGATECALL selects the proxy execution mode in the fallback.
Fallback performs a low-level call to the target when not delegating.
target address is read from storage for delegatecall/call.
CALL mode forwards msg.sender by invoking target.setMessageSender.
setMessageSender is gated by the onlyProxy modifier.
_emit is restricted to the target contract via onlyTarget.
_emit writes raw log0 through log4 assembly opcodes.
messageSender storage is written from the proxy supplied sender.
callTokenFallbackIfNeeded invokes the recipient low-level call.
isInFunctionBody acts as the reentrancy guard around the callback.
extcodesize length decides whether the recipient call is made.
tokenFallback can re-enter Synth.transfer before balances settle.
Synth.transfer reaches tokenFallback through _internalTransfer.
_internalTransfer calls callTokenFallbackIfNeeded after balance updates.
Synth.transfer performs the transfer through _internalTransfer.
External token state balance updates go through setBalanceOf.
External token state allowance updates go through setAllowance.
messageSender is used as the debited sender in Synth.transfer.
msg.sender feeds messageSender via the optionalProxy modifier.
exchange routes execution into _internalExchange.
protectionCircuit selects the liquidation branch of exchange.
exchangeEnabled gate must pass before internal exchange logic runs.
_internalExchange triggers tokenFallback on the destination synth.
effectiveValue reads exchange rates during internal exchange.
mint increases totalSupply via add operations on supply values.
mint credits escrow and minter balances through token state.
supplyToMint is derived from supplySchedule.mintableSupply.
Mintable supply depends on block.timestamp based schedule checks.
issueSynths records new debt in the global debt register.
burnSynths removes debt amounts from the register math.
Debt ownership math interacts with the issuance ratio state.
issuanceRatio bounds the amount issuable in issueSynths.
issueSynths mints synth balances through the token state.
burnSynths reduces balances through the token state.
amount parameter flows into issuance debt arithmetic.
currencyKey parameter selects the synth to issue.
messageSender identity determines whose collateral is used.
Minter reward is credited to the untrusted caller address.
purge triggers synth exchanges for each holder iterated.
purge is restricted to the proxy owner via optionalProxy_onlyOwner.
addresses array is iterated and exchanged during purge.
totalSupply feeds value and fee calculations in internal exchange.
setBalanceOf is restricted to the associated contract.
setAllowance is restricted to the associated contract.
amountReceived local is forwarded into the internal transfer.
rateIsStale derives its result from block.timestamp.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor owner argument feeds the ownership authorisation used by onlyOwner.
currencyKey parameter selects the synth issued inside issueSynths.
amount parameter is consumed by the issuance arithmetic in issueSynths.
addresses array parameter is iterated and exchanged inside purge.
extcodesize local only decides the recipient call in callTokenFallbackIfNeeded.
Cached beneficiary local is the destination of the selfdestruct operation.
newInverseRate local is computed and written by rateOrInverted.
amountReceived local is forwarded into _internalTransfer after fees.
supplyToMint local is the schedule amount credited by mint.
